units.meaning: The reviewing officer must request a missing inspection report if a permit application lacks a required inspection report, unless the applicant holds a valid exemption.
An applicant holding a valid exemption constitutes an exception to the requirement that the reviewing officer request a missing required inspection report.

As an example of the inspection report request requirement, the reviewing officer must ask a workshop applicant for its missing fire-safety inspection report, provided the application lacks it and the applicant does not hold a valid exemption.
Requests for an inspection report may be made voluntarily for applicants who hold a valid exemption.
Every request for an inspection report, including any request made voluntarily for an exempt applicant, must allow a minimum response time of at least ten working days.
